name: 51_stencil_edge_kernel
outputs:
from pycompss.api.task import task
from pycompss.api.api import compss_wait_on
from pycompss.api.parameter import *

@task(returns=1)
def edge_element(matrix, i, j, N):

    value = matrix[i][j]*8
    
    n1 = n2 = n3 = n4 = n5 = n6 = n7 = n8 = 0
    if i > 0:     n1 = -matrix[i - 1][j]
    if i < N - 1: n2 = -matrix[i + 1][j]
    if j > 0:     n3 = -matrix[i][j - 1]
    if j < N - 1: n4 = -matrix[i][j + 1]
    
    if i > 0     and j > 0:     n5 = -matrix[i - 1][j - 1]
    if i > 0     and j < N - 1: n6 = -matrix[i - 1][j + 1]
    if i < N - 1 and j > 0:     n7 = -matrix[i + 1][j - 1]
    if i < N - 1 and j < N - 1: n8 = -matrix[i + 1][j + 1]
    
    value += n1 + n2 + n3 + n4 + n5 + n6 + n7 + n8
    
    if value < 0:
        return 0
    elif value > 255:
        return 255
    else:
        return value

def main(matrix, N):
    output_matrix = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            output_matrix[i][j] = edge_element(matrix, i, j, N)

    output_matrix = compss_wait_on(output_matrix)

    return output_matrix
